incidents.title: NullPointerException in PaymentService.charge for EU customers
incidents.description: Charge requests failing with NPE for customers without a resolved billing country. Errors swallowed by generic catch and logged as timeouts. Masked the real cause for 2h.
incidents.rootCause: Missing null-check on `request` / `request.getCreditCard()` before `controller.clearPayment(request)`; generic `catch(Exception e)` swallows the NPE and surfaces it as a gRPC UNAVAILABLE, masking the real cause.
